name: ModelVariant763_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant763_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (after the delay two fans and a spray of shards flash in front of the slot with an eight-frame sprite, falling dots and a rolled triangle while the ambient light dims and recovers; from the ring start two pulsing rings of quads spread out and every colour fades. The first drawn frame returns 1 and the end returns 2); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-780/877 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
